basis_words: Silver: 1 date partition(s) listed under the Scope account-return table; the latest partition holds 863 feed accounts, one row each. Roster: the round-119 active-roster response (verified against the hash the round-119 record holds) carries 3040 rows and 3040 distinct ids, of which 96 carry a null or empty start date; 56 of those null-start ids are not in the latest partition and so fall outside this extract. Within the feed accounts: 40 carry a null roster start date and 39 carry the feed class NO_START_DATE_AT_SOURCE. Difference A minus B (null start in the roster, not NO_START_DATE_AT_SOURCE in the feed): 1 account(s), feed class word(s): RETURNED. Difference B minus A (NO_START_DATE_AT_SOURCE in the feed, not null in the roster): 0 account(s). Verdict DIFFERENCE_SHOWN. S60's account: in the roster null-start set; feed class NO_START_DATE_AT_SOURCE; outside either difference. This establishes the counts and class words of the latest partition against the roster file, over the feed accounts only. It does not establish the cause of any difference, the meaning of a null start date in the roster, or the state of any account outside the feed or in an earlier partition.
